titleEn: Minimum Number of Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram II
title: 使两字符串互为字母异位词的最少步骤数
summary: 每步可从任一字符串删除一个字符，求使两字符串字符频次相同的最少删除次数。
insight: 用一个频次数组对 s 加一、对 t 减一；每个字符的绝对差就是必须从某一侧删除的数量。
pitfalls: 答案是全部频次绝对差之和

solutions.title: 频次差绝对值求和
solutions.idea: 每个字符独立消除多余出现。
steps: 扫描 s 加一，扫描 t 减一

code.java: class Solution { public int minSteps(String s,String t){int[] difference=new int[26];for(char ch:s.toCharArray())difference[ch-'a']++;for(char ch:t.toCharArray())difference[ch-'a']--;int answer=0;for(int value:difference)answer+=Math.abs(value);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSteps(s:String,t:String):Int{val difference=IntArray(26);for(ch in s)difference[ch-'a']++;for(ch in t)difference[ch-'a']--;return difference.sumOf{kotlin.math.abs(it)}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minSteps(string s,string t){int difference[26]={};for(char ch:s)++difference[ch-'a'];for(char ch:t)--difference[ch-'a'];int answer=0;for(int value:difference)answer+=abs(value);return answer;} };
